meanings.en: a large grey rain cloud
meanings.exampleEn: A dark nimbus gathered over the hills before the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınadan önce tepelerin üzerinde kara bir yağmur bulutu toplandı.

meanings.en: a bright halo around a person or thing
meanings.exampleEn: The saint was painted with a golden nimbus around his head.
meanings.exampleTr: Aziz, başının etrafında altın bir hale ile resmedilmişti.

meanings.en: the number 9
meanings.exampleEn: There are nine players on a baseball team.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir beysbol takımında dokuz oyuncu vardır.

meanings.en: the number 19
meanings.exampleEn: She turned nineteen last month.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen ay on dokuz yaşına girdi.

meanings.en: the number 90
meanings.exampleEn: My grandfather is almost ninety years old.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükbabam neredeyse doksan yaşında.

meanings.en: to bite or pinch something sharply
meanings.exampleEn: The little dog tried to nip my ankle.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük köpek ayak bileğimi ısırmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: to go somewhere quickly (British informal)
meanings.exampleEn: I'll just nip to the shop for some milk.
meanings.exampleTr: Süt almak için hemen dükkâna kadar gidip geleceğim.

meanings.en: not any more
meanings.exampleEn: She no longer works here.
meanings.exampleTr: O artık burada çalışmıyor.

meanings.en: not any person; nobody
meanings.exampleEn: No one answered the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapıyı hiç kimse açmadı.

meanings.en: a system of names used in a particular field
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists use a standard nomenclature for naming new species.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları yeni türleri adlandırmak için standart bir adlandırma sistemi kullanır.

meanings.en: not causing addiction
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor prescribed a non-addictive painkiller.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor bağımlılık yapmayan bir ağrı kesici reçete etti.

meanings.en: containing no alcohol
meanings.exampleEn: They serve a range of non-alcoholic cocktails.
meanings.exampleTr: Çeşitli alkolsüz kokteyller servis ediyorlar.

meanings.en: failure to be present at something
meanings.exampleEn: His non-attendance at the meetings was noted.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantılara katılmaması not edildi.

meanings.en: a person who is not fighting in a war, such as a civilian
meanings.exampleEn: International law protects non-combatants during armed conflict.
meanings.exampleTr: Uluslararası hukuk, silahlı çatışma sırasında muharip olmayanları korur.

meanings.en: not safe to drink
meanings.exampleEn: The sign warned that the water was non-potable.
meanings.exampleTr: Tabela suyun içilemez olduğu konusunda uyarıyordu.

meanings.en: not connected with religion
meanings.exampleEn: They chose a non-religious wedding ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Dini olmayan bir düğün töreni seçtiler.

meanings.en: a relaxed and calm manner showing no worry or interest
meanings.exampleEn: He answered the difficult question with surprising nonchalance.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor soruyu şaşırtıcı bir kayıtsızlıkla yanıtladı.

meanings.en: (of a disease) not able to be passed from one person to another
meanings.exampleEn: Diabetes is a noncommunicable disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Diyabet bulaşıcı olmayan bir hastalıktır.

meanings.en: a material that does not conduct electricity or heat
meanings.exampleEn: Rubber is a good nonconductor of electricity.
meanings.exampleTr: Kauçuk, elektriği iyi iletmeyen bir yalıtkandır.

meanings.en: behaviour that does not follow accepted rules or customs
meanings.exampleEn: Her nonconformity often surprised her conservative colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurallara uymayan tavrı, muhafazakâr meslektaşlarını sık sık şaşırtıyordu.

meanings.en: not following one after another in order
meanings.exampleEn: He served two nonconsecutive terms as president.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkan olarak ardışık olmayan iki dönem görev yaptı.

meanings.en: not any; not one
meanings.exampleEn: None of the students passed the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrencilerin hiçbiri sınavı geçemedi.

meanings.en: a person without special qualities or importance
meanings.exampleEn: Before winning the award, he was a complete nonentity.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödülü kazanmadan önce tamamen silik biriydi.

meanings.en: the practice of not becoming involved in others' affairs
meanings.exampleEn: The government promised a policy of noninterference in local matters.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükûmet, yerel meselelere karışmama politikası vaat etti.

meanings.en: not supporting any particular political party or side
meanings.exampleEn: The report was prepared by a nonpartisan committee.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, tarafsız bir komite tarafından hazırlandı.

meanings.en: a person who does not follow or believe in a religion
meanings.exampleEn: As a nonreligious person, he never attended church.
meanings.exampleTr: Dindar olmayan biri olarak asla kiliseye gitmezdi.

meanings.en: a loop of rope that tightens as it is pulled, used to hang someone
meanings.exampleEn: The executioner placed the noose around the prisoner's neck.
meanings.exampleTr: Cellat, ilmeği mahkûmun boynuna geçirdi.

meanings.en: an informal way of saying no
meanings.exampleEn: "Did you finish it?" "Nope, not yet."
meanings.exampleTr: "Bitirdin mi?" "Hayır, henüz değil."

meanings.en: used after 'neither' or a negative to add another negative point
meanings.exampleEn: She neither called nor wrote.
meanings.exampleTr: Ne aradı ne de yazdı.

meanings.en: the quality of being too interested in other people's private affairs
meanings.exampleEn: Her constant nosiness annoyed the neighbours.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli her şeye burnunu sokması komşuları rahatsız ediyordu.

meanings.en: feeling happy and slightly sad thinking about the past
meanings.exampleEn: Old songs make me feel nostalgic about my childhood.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski şarkılar bana çocukluğumu nostaljik bir şekilde özletiyor.

meanings.en: (of an organization) not run in order to make a profit
meanings.exampleEn: She works for a not-for-profit organization that helps refugees.
meanings.exampleTr: Mültecilere yardım eden, kâr amacı gütmeyen bir kuruluşta çalışıyor.

meanings.en: especially; in particular
meanings.exampleEn: Several countries, notably Japan, have aging populations.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok ülke, özellikle Japonya, yaşlanan nüfusa sahip.

meanings.en: in a way that is noticeable
meanings.exampleEn: The quality has improved notably this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalite bu yıl belirgin biçimde arttı.

meanings.en: interesting or important enough to deserve attention
meanings.exampleEn: The report contains several noteworthy findings.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, dikkate değer birkaç bulgu içeriyor.

meanings.en: not anything; no single thing
meanings.exampleEn: There is nothing in the fridge.
meanings.exampleTr: Buzdolabında hiçbir şey yok.

meanings.en: existing only as an idea, not as something real
meanings.exampleEn: The budget was based on a notional figure rather than actual costs.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütçe, gerçek maliyetler yerine varsayımsal bir rakama dayanıyordu.

meanings.en: having no legal force; invalid
meanings.exampleEn: The contract was declared null and void.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşme geçersiz ve hükümsüz ilan edildi.

meanings.en: having no value; equal to zero or empty
meanings.exampleEn: The field returned a null value.
meanings.exampleTr: Alan boş bir değer döndürdü.

meanings.en: to make something legally invalid or cancel its effect
meanings.exampleEn: The court decided to nullify the agreement.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme anlaşmayı geçersiz kılmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: the state of being legally invalid
meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer argued for the nullity of the marriage.
meanings.exampleTr: Avukat, evliliğin hükümsüzlüğünü savundu.

meanings.en: unable to feel anything in a part of the body
meanings.exampleEn: My fingers were numb with cold.
meanings.exampleTr: Parmaklarım soğuktan uyuşmuştu.

meanings.en: unable to feel emotion; shocked
meanings.exampleEn: She felt numb after hearing the terrible news.
meanings.exampleTr: Korkunç haberi duyduktan sonra kendini duygusuz hissetti.

meanings.en: written symbols that represent numbers
meanings.exampleEn: Roman numerals are still used on some clocks.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı saatlerde hâlâ Roma rakamları kullanılır.

meanings.en: a building where nuns live; a convent
meanings.exampleEn: She spent several years in a nunnery before leaving.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayrılmadan önce birkaç yıl bir rahibe manastırında geçirdi.

meanings.en: a place where elderly or ill people are cared for
meanings.exampleEn: Her grandmother lives in a nursing home now.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannesi artık bir huzurevinde yaşıyor.

meanings.en: women's stockings made of nylon
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a pair of nylons under her skirt.
meanings.exampleTr: Eteğinin altına bir çift naylon çorap giymişti.

meanings.en: unpleasant or offensive; likely to cause disapproval
meanings.exampleEn: The film contains some objectionable scenes.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, sakıncalı bazı sahneler içeriyor.

meanings.en: a person who objects to something, especially officially
meanings.exampleEn: He was a conscientious objector who refused to fight.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaşmayı reddeden vicdani retçi bir itirazcıydı.

meanings.en: required to do something by law, duty, or circumstances
meanings.exampleEn: Employers are obliged to provide a safe workplace.
meanings.exampleTr: İşverenler güvenli bir çalışma ortamı sağlamakla yükümlüdür.

meanings.en: grateful for something someone has done
meanings.exampleEn: I'm much obliged to you for your help.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardımınız için size çok minnettarım.
